items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Because we was recording mostly with her at that time.

ctx.x: -- the Spirits of Rhythm. They alternated with us once. And then pretty soon -- they wouldn't change us but they'd change the other group sometimes. And once they had Billie Holiday working in there with us for a while. Not long, but for a while. Because we was recording mostly with her at that time.
